title: IVR vs AI Voice Agent: What Changes for Your Call Centre
description: IVR vs AI voice agent: what changes for callers and your call centre, where an IVR is still enough, the risks, and how to move across safely, step by step.
author: Yogansh Banthia

hero.alt: IVR vs AI voice agent: a headset with voice waves beside an old keypad menu

faq_heading: Questions call-centre teams ask about AI voice agents

faqs.q: How much does an AI voice agent cost compared with an IVR?
faqs.a: Cost depends on call volume, the call types, the languages and the systems the agent connects to. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the call types, the number of connections to your phone system and CRM, and how quickly your team approves the handover rules. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis, based on your actual material.

faqs.q: Do we have to replace our phone system?
faqs.a: Usually not. The agent connects to your existing telephony, and the IVR can stay in place while you move call types across one at a time. The exact set-up is confirmed during diagnosis.

faqs.q: Will callers know they are speaking to an AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent says at the start that it is an automated assistant, and callers can ask for a person at any time.

faqs.q: Which systems can it connect to?
faqs.a: Typically your CRM, calendar, helpdesk and phone system, so bookings and call summaries appear where your team already works. The exact list is confirmed during diagnosis.
